<DOCSTRING>
Manages user data and processes users based on their age.

This class is responsible for adding users, validating their data, and processing them accordingly. It ensures that only valid users are added and that their activities are appropriately handled based on their age.

Attributes:
    users (List[User]): List of users managed by this class. Each user is an instance of the User class.
</DOCSTRING>
